properties.statement:
REPRODUCED LIVE 2026-08-17 on a throwaway graph, before designing anything, and it reframes the requirement.

TWO ARTIFACTS, IDENTICAL EXCEPT FOR ONE EDGE. Both registered with no claim edges, exactly as the fleet's ruling prescribes. One also GOVERNED_BY an accepted Decision recording why no claims were extracted.
    art:bare  (no ruling)      -> orphan_node REPORTED
    art:ruled (GOVERNED_BY)    -> orphan_node NOT reported

⇒ SO THE MECHANISM ALREADY EXISTS AND THE PATH TO IT IS NOT TAKEN. GOVERNED_BY is not in `ARTIFACT_BOOKKEEPING`, so it counts as attachment; a node governed by its ruling is not an orphan. The fleet's 88 -> 97 climb across ten writes happens because the reason is recorded somewhere that is not an EDGE. This is the third time in one day that reflow2's vocabulary was present and unreached — after `description` (declared, unreachable from the constructor, 1 use in 164) and SUPERSEDES (declared, 0 edges, successor named in prose 9 times of 9).

⚠️⚠️ BUT SILENCE IS NOT WHAT THE REQUIREMENT ASKS FOR, AND THAT IS THE REAL GAP. Its words are: a marker "with `orphan_node` SKIPPING IT AND REPORTING `parked: N` SEPARATELY". Today the detector cannot COUNT a deliberate state — it can only fail to mention it. "Deliberately parked" and "never looked at" produce the identical answer, which is a vacuous zero wearing different clothes and exactly what `epoch:instruments-stop-overstating` exists to end. A boss reading "97 defects" cannot tell deliberate from real; a boss reading "34 defects, 8 parked" can.

AND THE SILENCE IS INCIDENTAL RATHER THAN INTENDED. `orphan_node` is not READING the ruling; it is seeing AN EDGE. A node governed by a completely unrelated Decision is silenced identically. So the requirement's ask — "a detector must be able to SEE that ruling and report the node accordingly" — is not met by what happens to work.

⭐ AND THE REPORTER'S OPEN BOUND IS NOW CLOSED. They wrote: "they did not check whether the guard built for the DOCUMENTS/REALIZES asymmetry was meant to cover this case and misses it, or whether this case was never contemplated." IT WAS NEVER CONTEMPLATED. BL-176 widened attachment to count REALIZES/DOCUMENTS/SPECIFIES/PRODUCES/SATISFIES — it is about artifacts that DO carry a describing edge and were wrongly called orphans. The fleet's case is an artifact that deliberately carries NO describing edge. Different case; the guard neither covers nor misses it.

CASE (b) IS GENUINELY UNSOLVED AND DIFFERENT. A Requirement deliberately left unsatisfied is reported by `unsatisfied_requirement`, a DETECT gap that looks for incoming SATISFIES — a GOVERNED_BY edge does not silence it and should not. That half needs the ruling to be readable, not merely present.
